channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Japan Economy Minister Kiuchi: Pass-through of rising costs has been limited so far
item.description: Japan Economy Minister Minoru Kiuchi said during the European trading session on Tuesday that the overall impact of the increase in the cost of goods has not yet been passed.

item.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) steadies around 100.00 as US-Iran tensions lend support
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick and currently trades around the 100.00 psychological mark, nearly unchanged for the day.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds gains above $58.50 on US-Iran talk signals
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around $58.70 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Silver prices are receiving support as non-yielding assets benefit from geopolitical and economic monitoring.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar softens below 0.5900 on US-Iran talks uncertainty, stronger US PMI data
item.description: The NZD/USD pair loses traction to near 0.5870 during the Asian trading hours on Tuesday, pressured by stronger US economic data and safe-haven flows. Traders brace for New Zealand’s employment report, which will be published later on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar gains as strong Job Ads, resurgent inflation signal hawkish RBA
item.description: AUD/USD rises after two days of losses, hovering around 0.7010 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) gained ground following the release of positive employment data, which showed that ANZ–Indeed Job Ads increased by 2.0% month-over-month in July.

item.title: Canadian Dollar consolidates below 1.4050 vs USD as rebounding oil prices cap upside
item.description: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest recovery gains and oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Tuesday. Spot prices currently trade just below the 1.4050 level, nearly unchanged for the day, amid mixed fundamental cues.

item.title: British Pound weakens below 1.3450 as US-Iran uncertainty boosts safe-haven US Dollar
item.description: The GBP/USD pair loses ground to near 1.3425 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. Uncertainty surrounding US-Iran talks drives traders toward a safe-haven currency such as the US Dollar (USD) against the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: WTI trades with positive bias below mid-$79.00s on Iran uncertainty, supply concerns
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – edges higher during the Asian session on Tuesday and looks to build on the overnight bounce following an intraday slump to levels below mid-$77.00s.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7917 vs. 6.7898 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Tuesday at 6.7917 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7898 and 6.7595 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro declines as US Dollar gains on Middle East uncertainty
item.description: EUR/USD remains subdued for the third successive day, trading around 1.1500 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen gathers strength as US, Japan confirm rare joint intervention
item.description: The USD/JPY pair edges lower to around 157.40 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Fed's Warsh weighs cutting regular FOMC meetings to six from eight a year
item.description: Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh is reportedly weighing whether the US central bank should hold fewer policy meetings each year, according to the New York Times, citing four people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Iran rejects any second corridor through Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iranian state television, advisor to the Supreme Leader, General Mohsen Rezaei said that the country will absolutely not allow the opening of a second corridor in the Strait of Hormuz, Reuters reported on Monday.

item.title: Gold declines to near $4,050 on US–Iran talks uncertainty
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) declines to near $4,050 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal eased slightly from the recent rally after the US paused planned airstrikes against Iran. Traders will closely monitor the developments surrounding US-Iran talks for fresh impetus.

item.title: Australian Dollar slides to 0.70 as US ISM PMI, revives the US Dollar
item.description: The Aussie Dollar retraces despite an overall risk-on mood as the US Dollar recovers some ground, sponsored by positive data, and easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. The AUD/USD trades at 0.7000 after reaching a daily high of 0.7050.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Bulls target 0.8150 after SMA bounce
item.description: The USD/CHF rises by about 0.27% on Monday as traders buy the Greenback following an intervention in FX markets by US and Japanese authorities.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar holds as traders brace for New Zealand jobs data
item.description: NZD/USD trades with a flat tone near the 0.5870 zone on Monday, holding onto the bulk of last week's advance but struggling to extend it as the US Dollar (USD) regains composure.

item.title: Forex Today: Oil collapses on Iran talks, Yen holds gains
item.description: Oil prices fell sharply on Monday amid growing expectations that talks between the US and Iran will resume soon. US President Donald Trump stated that conversations are underway after Tehran said it had no plans for direct negotiations.

item.title: Mexican Peso outpaces broad US Dollar strength ahead of Banxico’s rate decision
item.description: The Mexican Peso (MXN) gains ground against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday as risk appetite increases the carry-trade appeal of the emerging-market currency, while traders await the release of the Bank of Mexico (Banxico) monetary policy meeting later this week.

item.title: Gold slips as USD rebounds, strong ISM data clouds Fed path
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) price retreats on Monday as the US Dollar (USD) recovers some ground, even though hostilities in the Middle East paused at the request of Iran and other Middle Eastern countries, according to US President Donald Trump. The XAU/USD pair trades at $4,037, down 0.12%.

item.title: Trump: This is a last chance for Iran
item.description: United States (US) President Donald Trump said on Monday that Washington is currently holding talks with Iran, adding that the discussions are taking place at Tehran's request and describing them as a final opportunity for the Islamic Republic.

item.title: United States Dollar Index rebounds toward 100 amid US-Iran, Fed uncertainty
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) stages a modest comeback on Monday as stronger-than-expected US manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) data and uncertainty over US-Iran talks help the Greenback stabilize following last week’s sell-off, triggered by joint intervention from Washington and Tokyo to su

item.title: British Pound slips as strong ISM data revives the US Dollar
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) retreats some 0.27% on Monday as the Greenback recovers some ground amid a pause in US strikes on Iran, while both parties are expected to resume negotiations aimed at securing a rapid deal. The GBP/USD pair trades at 1.3439, after reaching a daily high of 1.3506.

item.title: Japanese Yen steadies near post-intervention highs ahead of BoJ Minutes
item.description: USD/JPY trades with a soft tone near the 156.90 area on Monday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) holds the bulk of the gains secured at the end of last week, when intervention by Japanese authorities and a relatively hawkish Bank of Japan (BoJ) policy announcement triggered a sharp unwind in the pair.

item.title: WTI Oil plunges as Trump revives US-Iran peace hopes
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil trades around $78.45 at the time of writing on Monday, down 7.76% on the day, as investors unwind the geopolitical risk premium following announcements of a potential agreement between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Technical outlook stays constructive above 0.8000
item.description: USD/CHF edges higher on Monday as softer Swiss inflation data and a modest recovery in the US Dollar (USD) weigh on the Swiss Franc (CHF). At the time of writing, the pair trades around 0.8109, up 0.38% on the day.

item.title: Australian Dollar slips after upbeat US ISM Manufacturing data
item.description: AUD/USD extends its pullback toward the 0.6990 area during Monday's American session after stronger-than-expected United States (US) manufacturing data reinforced the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Upside bias capped against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes USD/SGD slipped to 1.2809 but closed near 1.2821, with intraday bias still pointing lower.

item.title: Silver price falls as stronger US PMI reinforces hawkish Fed expectations
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) trades around $57.20 at the time of writing on Monday, down 0.73% on the day, after a strong US manufacturing report reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will maintain a restrictive monetary policy.

item.title: Gold consolidates as conflicting US-Iran headlines and hawkish Fed bets cap gains
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) trims gains after opening the week with a bullish gap as buyers lack conviction amid conflicting US-Iran headlines and caution ahead of key US employment data. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,036, easing from an intraday high of $4,084.
